definitions.closing_axis: TCP local +Y; driver states are hinge radians, not jaw gap
definitions.command_alignment: command k from actions.npz equals raw commanded_action[k+1], follows observation k
definitions.contact_duration: max consecutive physics samples * median physics dt; boundary-inclusive legacy descriptor
definitions.demo_wall_mode: nearest initial wall center to achieved TCP at closure in cup coordinates; geometric proxy, not measured pad contact
definitions.early_grasp: obs 0..min(close+60,900), TCP/cup XY <0.06 m, cup lift <0.01 m; null when no eligible sample
definitions.gate: first close command and measured TCP world Z - FK requested TCP world Z > 0.005 m; diagnostic trigger, not grasp proof
definitions.tilt: hypothetical rigid cup tilt 2/5/10 degrees about 72 horizontal axes; no measured dynamic rotation
